timelineEvents.title: Songs beyond cinema
timelineEvents.label: 22 June 1934 · Songs beyond cinema
timelineEvents.shortDescription: Jurmann–Kaper songs move beyond cinema into the French concert and festival repertoire.
timelineEvents.longDescription: Jurmann–Kaper songs enter the French concert repertoire. At a summer festival in Montpellier, a jazz orchestra performs "Ninon, quand tu me souris" from "Tout pour l'amour" on an open-air stage.
